svg.title: Fizz Level Studio
svg.desc: A level editor for Lieutenant Fizz. On a dark banner, tiles of a level drop onto a grid on the left and assemble into ground, a platform and a wall while a yellow treat falls into place on the platform; on the right a switch toggles a channel, a red door slides open and shut, and the name Fizz Level Studio sits in the middle.
svg.text: tiles, doors and channels. paint, check, export.
